text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The four main sources of spontaneous endogenous DNA mutation

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Even without external radiation or mutagens, water chemistry and polymerase slippage damage DNA thousands of times per cell per day

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Cytosine deamination (C → U)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Water removes −NH₂ from C → Uracil.

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Normally caught fast by UNG glycosylase

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (because U does not belong in DNA!).

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If missed before replication → C:G to T:A.

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. 5-Methylcytosine deamination (CpG hotspot!)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deaminating 5-mC creates Thymine (T:G)!

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Because T IS a normal DNA base, repair is

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: slower & error-prone → ~10× higher mutation

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rate at methylated CpG dinucleotides.

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Spontaneous depurination (~5,000/cell/day)

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hydrolysis breaks the glycosidic bond of

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A or G → leaves an abasic (AP) site.

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Repaired by BER; if bypassed by translesion

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pol, 'A-rule' inserts A → transversion.

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Replication slippage on tandem repeats

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pol momentarily dissociates on (CAG)n or

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: homopolymers and re-anneals out of register.

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Loop on nascent strand → insertion (+1 repeat);

text.font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: loop on template strand → deletion (−1 repeat).
